title: can anyone recommend a good electric breast pump?

posts.body:
I bf my first for 5 and a half weeks, my second for 4 and a half months and im hoing to at least do a year this time around with baby number 3.
I have a avent isis manual breast pump and that took pee lol, plus i need a dual pump for the simple reason when i start the other gushes and i loose alot of milk.
Im a good milker if not too good - i have to perminantly wear breast shells which fill up over night and the slightest move and im drenched lol!
I guess im lucky to have alot of milk when i bf, i remember shopping in Tesco's once, and i thought hmmm im rather full and baby just woke so we took him to be fed  in baby rooms, got me boob out and it just squirted for about a minute like a tap, poor chap couldnt suckle as he was chocked his tiny mouth filled up too much.
ANy advice much appreciated - thanks xx
